overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: HalloWiebe: Overdrive
overview: Wiebe and his team of security guards face their most challenging task yet.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Multwoh
overview: Marcel is a queer individual who mysteriously becomes a ghost (“multwoh”) on the night she finally decides to confess her love to her long‑time crush, Miguel. Because Marcel dies before she can say “I love you,” her spirit lingers, trying to find a way to express her feelings from beyond the grave.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: Dead Hungry
overview: 2026 Puregold CinePanalo Film Festival finalist

title: FINI DE RIRE ! L'humour politique au garde-à-vous ?
Justin the Just
overview: France, World War I. Justin (Alban Ivanov), an illiterate peasant farmer is enrolled in French army. Knowing nothing of the World or the War, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why he must kill men he’s never met. Naïve and open minded, Justin will cross the path of a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his fellow comrades to risk their lives. Through his journey Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifetime friends and inspire many…

title: Kanibal
overview: When a mayor pushes to privatize their public market, a struggling meat vendor confronts the brutal cost of “progress.”

title: Teks Battle: Shoot Pati Pato!
overview: In a small barangay where a children’s game of teks reflects real power, Maya challenges Rod, the reigning champion turned tyrant, in a teks battle that could change the fate of their community.

title: Penguin
overview: Returning from Antarctica, a man brings his partner a rare gift. The gift causes a shift in their relationship, which is difficult to cope with. Has the man changed, or is it the woman who suddenly sees him differently?

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: The Paradise
overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: Victorian Psycho
overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: 7 children vanish from the same neighborhood. 4 are later found brutally dismembered, and the clock is ticking to find the rest. AGNES, editor-in-chief of Daily Wave News, has long dismissed the supernatural after the tragic loss of her daughter. But when a child is abducted before her very eyes, she is forced to confront a mystery far darker than she ever imagined. Alongside fellow journalists CIA, BRINA, and ANYA , and aided by police officer PETRA, Agnes uncovers a chilling case that blurs the line between reality and the unknown. As the danger closes in, they are left with only two choices: walk away and save themselves, or risk everything to protect the children they still have a chance to save.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Shame and Money
overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

title: POSSESSION: The Darkness Within
overview: Odysseas Zervas, a grieving painter plagued by visions, confronts a sinister figure who mirrors his fears. As reality dissolves, his family seeks help, while a monk races to save him from a spiritual force that claims both sanity and soul.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: Rico, a young man raised in Melbourne, and Santun, the pious daughter of a respected Islamic boarding school leader (Kiai Umar), fall deeply in love despite coming from different worlds. Through Santun, Rico learns to appreciate religious values, and they both view their relationship as a form of worship. However, their romance faces a major obstacle: Santun's father has already betrothed her to Ustad Salman, the man her parents chose for her.

title: What Lies Between Us
overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

title: Street Race
overview: A meatheaded man is stopped next to an innocent baby in a stroller who accidentally intimidates him into a street race.

title: Virtuous Women
overview: A VIP retreat for women seeking their best selves turns into an absurd and dangerous journey.

title: Not Every Love Story Ends in Death
overview: Sol falls in love with Lola, a young deaf actress, and they begin a romance. Everything gets complicated when Lola starts living under the same roof as Sol's ex-husband, Miguel. In this curious triangle, they will discover that the death of one love can be the birth of another.

title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
overview: Captain Gennadiy Nevelskoy, an excellent student at the Naval Academy, is forced by his talent to teach naval science to the Tsarevich instead of conquering distant seas, watching as other people's dreams replace his own. Fourteen-year-old Nadezhda, a young student at the Institute for Noble Maidens, has never found her place in the capital. Deep down, she knows her true home is lost somewhere in the lands of the Far East, and she must return there. Upon meeting each other, Gennadiy and Nadezhda embark on a great and dangerous adventure-a search for themselves and their place in the world.

title: Brohr
overview: In the near future in Blokhavn, 24-year-old craftsman Ali lives in the ghetto area Valhalalparken with his wife Yasmina. Their everyday life changes drastically when the rich man Jasper Puch sends high-tech robots into the labor market, which immediately take over all the underpaid jobs. The residents of Valhalalparken, including Ali and Yasmina, lose their income and are reluctantly forced to relocate to Nakskov on Lolland. In the meantime, the robots start demolishing Valhalalparken so that expensive luxury apartments can be built for the rich citizens. However, Ali refuses to let go of his beloved hometown and decides to gather his old group of friends Hassan, Davito, Ahmed, Abdi, Musti, even though they are no longer on speaking terms. Ali manages to persuade them, and together they go on a wild and crazy adventure in the fight against the robots and Jasper Puch to win back their jobs and their beloved Blokhavn.

title: Mrs Winkler Leaves the House
overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

title: The Ultimate Planet
overview: After an accident, memories of his service on the Ninth Planet flash in the mind of auto mechanic Dima Khrust: amazing landscapes, the base of earthlings, battles with monsters, friends and his beloved girl Polina, whom he once saved... Khrust's colleagues twist their fingers at their temples, because theirs is completely different - ordinary army memories. But when Dima meets Polina in real life, he no longer doubts: someone corrected their memories. Who and why? The truth can only be found out by returning to the dangerous planet.

title: Девочки учатся бриться
overview: The late 1990s. Best friends Misha and Taya dream of escaping the small coastal town where adults have long since decided what their future should be. The brash Misha falls in love with a new teacher, while the quiet Taya hides the fact that her parents are planning to marry her off to a foreigner to save the family. Their friendship, through betrayal and pain, becomes a pillar of strength: they understand that growing up doesn't mean running away, but rather learning to stand up for yourself, even if it means being hurt by reality.

title: Are You Sleeping?
overview: Night. Air raid sirens. Insomnia. A girl returns to a city she barely recognizes and confronts the changes in it and its inhabitants.

title: Memórias do Cárcere
overview: Accused of adultery, Ana Augusta Plácido and Camilo Castelo Branco were imprisoned for more than a year in the Porto Prison, she in June 1860, he in October of the same year, after an adventurous escape from justice through the lands of the North.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: Láska
overview: 30-year-old Anna seeks a stable foundation in her relationships but unknowingly repeats the manipulative patterns learned from her mother. When she crosses paths with a terminally ill patient and his devoted wife, Anna experiences a profound love that transforms her life.

title: The Maggots
overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

title: Bibi Blocksberg - Die total verhexte Zeitreise
Emil and the Detectives
overview: Emil is spending his summer vacation with his grandmother in Berlin. But on the train there, he is robbed by the ruthless con artist Max Grundeis and a wild adventure begins! Together with his friends Pony, Gustav, Dienstag, Anh, and Jason, Emil sets off in pursuit and embarks on a fast-paced detective hunt across Berlin.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: Echo of Tomorrow's War
overview: The EU has fallen apart, and in Germany, far-right populists are forming a new government. War is imminent. Jonas has deserted; he and his sister go into hiding at the home of their father, Stuber, whom Jonas has not seen since childhood. But there, the situation escalates. A catastrophe occurs even before the war has begun.

title: Doomsday Radio
overview: On April 15, 2025, a forgotten Soviet "Doomsday" radio suddenly comes to life, broadcasting encrypted messages. An abstract animated film about echoes from the past disrupting the present.

title: Expo Inferno
overview: In 2067, the Canadian government resurrects Expo 67 using advanced projection technology. As a woman searches for the ghost of her grandfather, the exhibition catches fire.

title: The Day I Smoked a Cigarette with My Father
overview: Cairo, 1964. Alaa, a 12-year-old boy, and his three younger siblings hear shouting from the street. Outside, the crowd is cheering for a man. The children can barely believe their eyes: the man is their father, Ibrahim.

title: La Bola Negra
overview: Set across three timelines — Republican Spain in 1932, the Civil War in 1937, and contemporary Spain in 2017 — the film follows a constellation of interconnected lives centered on three young men, whose emotional and political echoes gradually reveal themselves.

title: Unabomber
overview: The story of Ted Kaczynski’s transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber, who carried out a nationwide bombing campaign in the U.S. from 1978 to 1995, killing 3 people and injuring 23. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Crawlers
overview: When a man returns from a trip unwittingly harboring a new breed of arachnid, the people in an apartment block are quarantined and left to fend for themselves against a plague of venomous spiders.

title: Butterfly
overview: Two sisters raised on a charter resort in Gran Canaria. After 27 years, they reluctantly return to their childhood island to deal with their parents death, and end up with a half-finished esoteric retreat center in the Canary Islands.

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Stolen Birthday
overview: On his birthday, Ronnie, a lonely middle-aged man, sits in a small diner having dinner with his mother, Julie. For Ronnie, the moment feels warm and real. They talk, laugh, and share the kind of comfort that only comes from being with someone who knows you deeply. As the night continues, small details begin to feel off. The people around Ronnie react to him with confusion, and it slowly becomes clear that Julie is not actually sitting across from him. The birthday dinner exists only in Ronnie's mind. In reality, he is homeless, alone, and struggling with his mental health. When the illusion begins to fall apart, Ronnie is forced back into the world he has been trying to escape. What felt like a simple birthday dinner becomes a heartbreaking look at grief, loneliness, and the ways people create their own sense of comfort when reality becomes too painful.

title: Epitaph
overview: Shortly after breaking up, Marcelo and Camila end up locked inside their apartment. The time they spend together after the breakup awakens a series of memories in each of them.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: The Body Is  A Political Matter
The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: The Stunt Driver
overview: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

title: Sonny Mango
overview: From Venus to Mars, through sun and earth. From Venus to Sonny Mango. That is the journey - or more specifically, the experience - that defines Anton, who describes, in the smoothest way possible, the state of mind that surrounds the powerless artist meeting his creator.

title: Numb
overview: A boy who no longer speaks, shaped by a tyrannical father and a mother he both resents and loves, grows up on Japan's northern coast. With nowhere to belong, he returns to seek his father and sets his fate in motion.

title: The Vvaan
overview: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest & awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that some powers exist beyond logic & he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

title: Five Orphans
overview: Five orphans walk along a ditch in a society where protests against the government are on the rise.

title: Acharya
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Nagi Notes
overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

title: The Other Ones
overview: Invoking the wrath of an ancient terror, a mother and daughter must rely on one another to confront the trauma that has plagued their family over generations.

title: Beasts Clutching at Straws
overview: After stumbling upon 100m yen at work, Kanji finds himself involved in a battle royal for the money. Based on the novel by Keisuke Sone

title: Baby Daddy
overview: A lonely three-year-old pulls out a chunk of his dad's beard, plants it in the garden, and grows a new best friend.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
overview: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

title: Nightmare School – The Mystery of Professor Marabecca
overview: Set in the imposing Kaiser Academy—a private boarding school that looks like something out of a Gothic novel—*Nightmare School* tells the story of Vittoria’s inexplicable disappearance. A group of friends—Isa, Michi, and Gibbo—join forces to search for her, discovering that the school is far more than a place of learning: it is steeped in legend, a guardian of dangerous secrets, and presided over by an authoritarian headmistress who is the heir to a shadowy alchemist founder…

title: The Intro
overview: This film chronicles the beginning of R&B/Pop icon Zaire Bloomfield's music career through the music videos leading up to the release of his first album

title: Kushti
overview: A touching comedy-drama about a wrestling-loving couple torn by clashing personalities. They can't live together, yet can't stay apart. This story is a humorous, emotional journey of love, struggle, and deep connection.

title: Black Market
overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Virose
overview: A teenager believes his pills are making him suffer, his family and girlfriend doubt it until it’s too late.

title: Cat People
overview: As Athens faces a stray cat crisis, two veterinarians and a network of volunteers give their time and resources to help the city’s overwhelming cat population

title: Wolpie of the Woods
overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

title: Heaven's Office Games
overview: Four carefree bachelors get into a car accident after a night of partying and find themselves in purgatory — a world of endless bureaucracy and chaotic digital reforms. At the Heaven’s Office, they receive their sentence: a direct express train to hell. Using their charm, they convince the purgatory secretary to give them a chance — seven days on Earth to atone for their sins. But once back, they realize they’ve fallen into a trap hidden in the perfectly ironic fine print of heaven.

title: Whispers in the Witch House
overview: Upon moving into the house of a deceased relative, a woman begins to notice peculiar happenings around her.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, the film UNSHATTER weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: Melpomène
overview: Marthe discovers her mother’s death was a suicide, not an accident. At the hospital where she was once institutionalized, Marthe investigates the past—unraveling family secrets and facing a disturbing truth that threatens her grip on reality.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Set in 1968 in Kanchanaburi, Thailand, the story follows Yak, a soldier from the Black Tiger Division, sent on an urgent mission into the forest of Khao Khwang to find Thap, a missing military intelligence officer.

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: Kraken
overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

title: In Limbo
overview: What happens after death?  After committing suicide, a young woman embarks on a winding journey into the afterlife.

title: Forever Your Maternal Animal
overview: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.

title: Die Sandale meiner Schwester
overview: A day at the public pool turns into complete chaos when two sisters dive for a sandal.

title: A Girl’s Story
overview: During a book signing in Normandy, Annie Ernaux, 70, revisits her memories of the summer of 1958, when she was 17. That summer, she left her hometown to work as a camp counsellor. At the first party, the head counsellor set out to deflower her. Finding him handsome, she lets him do it, as if against her will... Her body becomes a foreign place for her, an offering to be sacrificed.

title: PWRCR33P
overview: A lonely arcade regular finds fame and belonging through a new VR game that places him atop a global leaderboard—until cracks in the simulation force him to question what winning actually means.
